rationale: Revised plan addresses three failed checks identified in evaluation. Financial summary statistics parameter changed from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to report median, p90, and p99 percentiles alongside sums and means, capturing the true distribution shape of claim amounts. Write report show_denominators parameter changed from false to true to display all rates explicitly as 'numerator / denominator = rate', ensuring transparency and enabling readers to verify calculations and understand metric scope. This change also satisfies the denominator_format requirement by automatically generating the required format. All other components and parameters retained as they performed correctly. Retrieved skill evolved_run_012_001 continues to apply for synthetic data caveat disclosure.
changes_summary: Fixed two critical parameters: (1) financial_summary statistics changed from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to report quantile statistics (median, p90, p99) per feedback T2-paid_amount_quantiles; (2) write_report show_denominators changed from false to true to display rates as 'numerator / denominator = rate' per feedback T2-show_denominators and T2-denominator_format.
